name: Zotero-DataServer
description: Self-hosted Zotero sync server (dataserver): the backend that syncs Zotero libraries including items, notes, PDF attachments and annotations. Runs the PHP dataserver with MariaDB, memcached, Valkey, MinIO (S3 attachment storage), the Node.js stream server and the TinyMCE clean server behind nginx, plus the Zotero web library (browser client with PDF/EPUB reader) served login-gated at /. Deploys prebuilt releases from esatbayhan/zotero-selfhosted (upstream publishes none) and updates in place. Zotero desktop clients must be repointed at this server with the bundled patch script.

notes.text: Zotero provides no official selfhosting support and no dataserver releases; this script deploys prebuilt, pinned releases from esatbayhan/zotero-selfhosted.
The web library (browser client) is served at / behind a login and installs by default; set ZOTERO_WEB_LIBRARY=no at install time to skip it.
Zotero desktop clients must be patched to use this server: copy /opt/zotero-dataserver_data/client-patch/ to the client machine and follow its README.
The initial sync account is created during installation; credentials are stored in /root/zotero-dataserver.creds. Server-side full-text search is disabled (no Elasticsearch).
MinIO must stay reachable on port 9000 from all client machines; attachment up/downloads use presigned URLs pointing at it.
